_comment: Worker safety settings for Windows (passed to every worker by start-worker.ps1 -Safety; macOS / Linux: settings.example.json). Replace C:\ABSOLUTE\PATH with the real absolute path to the coordinator folder on this machine (JSON needs \\ for each backslash). This is the AUTONOMOUS baseline (the default level): only the protected branches and irreversible removals are guarded; workers do routine risky work themselves and report it. The CAUTIOUS level adds: "Bash(gh pr merge*)", "Bash(gh pr ready*)", "Read(**/.env*)" and the stack candidates chosen in the init quiz (examples/nextjs-supabase/settings.json). Also add gh pr merge / ready denies wherever PROJECT.md says humans merge or mark ready.
